# Frozen baseline: files below the UI layer that import the presentation
# layer (lib/{providers,services,repositories,state} -> screens/widgets/router),
# plus route providers that import UI code or the router barrel. Generated by
# scripts/check_layer_direction.sh. The baseline may only SHRINK (growth fails
# CI vs origin/main). A trailing '# reason' marks intent.
lib/providers/active_video_provider.dart # reads pageContextProvider (route parser); needs a leaf route-context provider
lib/providers/image_crop_launcher_provider.dart # launches a screen directly; needs a navigation port
lib/providers/readiness_gate_providers.dart # reads pageContextProvider (route parser)
lib/providers/route_feed_providers.dart # reads pageContextProvider (route parser)
lib/providers/storage_providers.dart # uses VineCachedImage cache manager; belongs in a media package
lib/providers/swap_account.dart # rebuilds the router on account swap; needs a router-layer home
lib/providers/video_publish_provider.dart # navigates after publish; needs a navigation port
lib/router/providers/redirect_provider.dart # ExploreScreen.pathForTab carries tab-slug grammar, not just a location
lib/services/age_verification_service.dart # shows a dialog; belongs behind a UI callback
lib/services/back_button_handler.dart # inspects the route stack; belongs in the router layer
lib/services/email_verification_listener.dart # navigates via goRouterProvider; belongs in the router layer
lib/services/password_reset_listener.dart # navigates via goRouterProvider; belongs in the router layer
lib/services/video_editor/draft_render_parameters_service.dart # reuses the sticker widget model; extract the model
